title: worktree-ports.json
description: Repository config for worktree-ports: the services that need a port in each git worktree.

services.description: Service name to port spec. The port is the claimed block base plus the offset.

offset.description: Unique integer >= 0. The service's port is the block base plus this offset.

default.description: Port used by every context that does not claim a block. Must lie outside the claim range.

mainCheckout.description: Whether the main checkout uses the defaults or claims a block like a linked worktree.

env.description: Environment variable name to template. Tokens: {root}, {name}, {home} and {<service>}.

verify.description: How `exec --verify` asks a running service which checkout it belongs to.
